output.content: The allocation module branch in the repository does not contain a file defining acceptance criteria. The build pipeline executes the nightly forecast job for every store without referencing that file. The promotion allocation script runs when a buyer locks a middle aisle week, processing spreadsheet inputs directly. No validation step checks for the criteria before the output is served to the ordering system. The store manager app displays the suggested order during the morning window. The system compiles and deploys successfully. Data flows to the distribution centres as usual. The retraining cycle completes without flagging the missing document. The code runs on schedule for all regions. The absence of the criteria file does not interrupt the data pipeline or the generation of replenishment orders.
output.reclassify_reason: The artifact describes the current operational state of the system, noting that the absence of the acceptance criteria file does not interrupt the pipeline or order generation, without expressing any wish, refusal, or stated need.
